text:
maria_g: Quick sync — Catalyst (reseller) asked for a joint POC tenant map and clarification on how we surface per-tenant entitlements. need to align before Tue demo.
aj_solutions: Thx. Do they want separate staging tenants per end-customer or a single shared tenant with routing? I remember they preferred isolated tenants for compliance.
leo_sales: They requested isolated tenants plus separate billing meters. pricing wants to know how to forecast 99th percentile usage per tenant.
sam_ops: Can do isolated tenants. Need to confirm whether they expect dedicated VPC or shared VPC with network tags. Dedicated will add infra lead time.
dan_security: Security Qs: will Catalyst manage SSO through their IdP or do we onboard customers into our enterprise SSO? Also need to know if any customers in the POC are in scope for PCI/PHI.
maria_g: Catalyst will use their Okta for reseller admin and then provision downstream customer IdPs. A few pilot customers handle PHI — flagged that for legal.
aj_solutions: For entitlements, we can map rate limits + model caps per tenant. Two implementation options: (1) separate tenants with metadata + independent quotas; (2) shared tenant with tenant_id routing and enforced per-tenant quotas. Both supported.
leo_sales: Pricing needs a simple line: per-tenant reserved capacity vs shared burst. What numbers should I give them for a 3-customer pilot? rough TCO.
sam_ops: For reserved capacity: suggest a single Dedicated pool with 2x burst nodes and per-tenant weight-based allocation. I'll draft numbers: baseline 4 vGPU equivalent, burst 8. ETA for provision ~ 7 business days if dedicated.
maria_g: Can we automate tenant provisioning? Catalyst wants a self-serve CLI or UI to spin a tenant for each reseller customer during the POC.
aj_solutions: Yes — we have the tenant API. Example provisioning call (pseudo): ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/tenants -d '{"name":"cust-a","tier":"pilot","quota":{}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'``` Sam can confirm perms and entitlements.
sam_ops: noted. Need service account for Catalyst with role=tenant_admin. Also will open infra ticket to pre-configure routing, egress filters, and NATs if dedicated VPC.
dan_security: For the PHI customers, we need to enforce data-at-rest encryption keys separate from Catalyst. KMS key per-customer or per-tenant? Recommend per-tenant CMKs and HSM-backed keys for pilot.
leo_sales: Legal asked about contract language for telemetry — Catalyst wants logs for debugging, but not full PII. We should offer redacted logs + aggregated telemetry. Can we turn on high-fidelity logs per tenant on request?
aj_solutions: Yes, toggleable via console. We'll produce a short runbook for redaction settings and retention.
maria_g: Blockers: (1) KMS per-tenant decision, (2) provisioning automation demo, (3) pricing draft for reserved vs shared. Owners: dan for KMS, sam for infra ticket + demo pods, aj for pricing draft.
deploy-bot: infra-ticket-48291 created by sam_ops for dedicated pool provisioning (ETA 7d).
leo_sales: I'll consolidate the pricing draft and send to Catalyst by EOD tomorrow. Sharing the pilot assumptions for review.
dan_security: I'll scope KMS options and check HSM availability in their target region. Update by Tue.
maria_g: Awesome. Let's meet Mon 10am to review the runbook and demo script. agenda: provisioning flow, entitlements UI, pricing table, security checklist. :thumbsup:
